## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Numerical or methodological reference

For translated statistical behavior, identify the R package/version,
functions, source files, papers, or equations used as references.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Python tests pass.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] R parity fixtures were added or regenerated when applicable.
- [ ] CPU and CUDA behavior were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated build artifacts are included.
